report.summary: Cross-shard census review of shard05 found a contradiction in daedalus/structcore/dss.py (claims dependency-free but DEPENDS on forest), several UNWIRED functions in daedalus/core.py with no consumers, missing reader for OUTBOX/INBOX/ARCHIVE writes, and potentially overstated single-source-of-truth claim in provider_router. Census omissions noted: no writer for runs/progress/events.jsonl. These warrant review.
risks: daedalus/structcore/dss.py claims 'dependency-free' but DEPENDS entry shows dependency on daedalus/structcore/forest.

UNWIRED symbols in daedalus/core.py (provider_health, model_resources, get_queue, get_squads, enforcement_status, get_quality, routing_summary) have no DEPENDS from other files in this shard, suggesting potential dead code.
daedalus/core.py WRITES OUTBOX/INBOX/ARCHIVE but no file in this shard READS them; possible orphaned output or incomplete census.
daedalus/progress.py READS runs/progress/events.jsonl but no file in this shard WRITES it (progress.py likely writes but not listed), indicating census gap.
daedalus/provider_router.py claims _deepseek_write_allowed is 'single source of truth'; cross-shard verification needed to avoid duplication.
todos: Verify daedalus/structcore/dss.py dependency on forest; if true, correct CLAIMS to remove 'dependency-free'.
Investigate UNWIRED functions in daedalus/core.py to determine if they are dead code or missed in other shards.
Confirm daedalus/core.py OUTBOX/INBOX/ARCHIVE have consumers in other shards; if none, evaluate removal.
Ensure daedalus/progress.py's writing of events.jsonl is documented in census WRITES; update shard transcription.
Review daedalus/provider_router.py's write-allow logic against other shards to confirm sole authority.
